factor_candidates_testable.name: Vol Rank Stability (3m rank change)
factor_candidates_testable.definition: Cross-sectional volatility rank change over 3 months. For each stock at month t: compute 12m trailing realized vol (from daily returns) → cross-sectional rank (1=lowest vol) → signal = -(rank_t - rank_{t-3}). Negative rank change = vol rank improving = buy signal. PIT lag=1 (prior month end data).
factor_candidates_testable.db_closest: C-family low-vol factors (IVOL, realized vol) — rank-transition angle not in DB

factor_candidates_testable.name: Monthly Return Autocorrelation (12m lag-1)
factor_candidates_testable.definition: Lag-1 autocorrelation of monthly returns over trailing 12m window. For each stock at month t: corr(ret[t-12:t-2], ret[t-11:t-1]) cross-section. High positive autocorrelation = persistent trend = buy signal. PIT lag=1 (use returns through t-1).
factor_candidates_testable.novel: uncertain — T15_AutoCorr (21d daily) exists; monthly frequency at cross-section may differ. possibly correlated with M01 momentum.
